topic.title: Junos Provider Escalation

beforeEscalating.item: Physical Interface Link State (show interfaces terse)
Optical Light Levels in dBm (show interfaces diagnostics optics)
Input/Output Error & Framing Counters (show interfaces extensive)
Pseudowire / VC Connection State (show l2circuit connections)
IGP / BGP Adjacency Status (show isis adjacency / show bgp summary)
Diagnostic Tests Performed (MPLS VCCV Ping / ICMP Ping)

providerRequest.item: Remote handoff port link state and speed/duplex negotiation
Optical Tx/Rx power levels at provider demarcation point
Interface framing and CRC/FCS error counters
LOS / LOF / AIS alarms on transport path
Underlay transport network and middle-mile path health
Scheduled or unscheduled vendor maintenance activity
Recent fiber cuts or maintenance changes on target path

topic.evidencePrinciple: A provider escalation must contain concrete Junos operational telemetry (exact dBm light levels, flap timestamps, CRC error counts, and pseudowire status codes) rather than generic "circuit is down" claims.
